resources.string: Enable to control editing from notification
Block or modify any unwanted UI elements on any app
Show or hide app icon from launcher

1. Getting Started
1. Master Switch: Settings → General → GodMode switch. A notification appears when enabled.
2. Notification Toggle: Tap the notification to toggle between "Start editor" and "Exit editor".
3. Quick Tile: Use the Quick Settings tile to toggle edit mode with one tap.
 Disabling the master switch forces edit mode off and removes the notification.

2. Tool Panel
When edit mode is active, a semi-transparent rounded toolbar appears on the right side of the target app:

Buttons (top to bottom):
• Vertical Slider — Drag to select elements at different hierarchy depths.
• 🔀 Toggle Position — Switch the panel between right and left side.
• Remove Mode button — Expands remove menu (🚫 Block, 👁 Preview).
• Modify Mode button — Expands modify menu (✏️ Properties, 💾 Save).
• ⬆ Previous / ⬇ Next — Navigate elements one by one.

Show / Hide:
• Press Volume Up or Volume Down and release → toggle the panel.
• When the panel is visible, volume keys navigate between elements.

3. Selecting Elements
A red overlay highlights the currently selected element. Switch selection via:
• Tap to Select: Tap any element on the screen.
• Slider: Drag the vertical slider on the panel.
• ⬆⬇ Buttons: Tap Previous / Next on the panel.
• Volume Keys: When panel is visible, volume keys step through elements.

4. Remove Mode
Tap the "Remove Mode" button to expand the submenu:

👁 Preview
Tap Preview → the selected element is temporarily hidden. Tap again to restore.

🚫 Block (three equivalent methods):
1. Panel: Select element → tap the Block button on the panel.
2. Touch: Long-press an element ~0.5s → green overlay appears with a cancel area at the top → release outside the green area → particle animation plays and the element disappears.
3. Drag to Cancel: Long-press, then drag the green overlay to the top green zone and release → operation cancelled.
 After blocking, the rule and a screenshot are saved automatically.

5. Modify Mode
Tap the "Modify Mode" button to expand the submenu:

✏️ Property Panel
1. Select the target element, then tap the Modify button on the panel.
2. The property panel appears with controls for:
 • Width / Height — SeekBar drag or manual input.
 • Alpha — 0~255 slider.
 • Position Nudge — Arrow buttons move the element 10px per tap.
 • Text — Edit text content for TextViews.
 • Replace Image — Pick an image from the gallery for ImageViews.
3. Tap Confirm to preview changes, or Cancel to revert.

Drag to Reposition
 In modify mode, long-press anywhere on the screen to drag the currently selected element (not the element under your finger).
 • 16dp Grid Snap: Moves align to a grid.
 • 12dp Edge Snap: Automatically snaps to adjacent element edges.
 • Position is auto-saved on release as a modify rule.

💾 Save Modifications
 After confirming changes in the property panel, tap the Save button to persist all modifications. A screenshot with red overlay is generated automatically.

6. Rule Management
• View List: Settings → App Rules → tap package name. Use menu to filter All / Remove / Modify rules. Title shows rule count.
• View Details: Tap a rule entry → swipe left/right to browse. View screenshot, view info, layout depth, etc.
• Edit Alias: Customize alias from rule details for easy identification.
• Delete Single: Rule details → menu → Delete rule.
• Delete All: Rule list → menu → Delete rules.
• Backup: Rule list/details → menu → Export as .gzip file.
• Restore: Settings → menu → Choose a .gzip backup to import.

7. Notes
• Edit mode only works in third-party apps where the module is activated in Xposed / LSPosed.
• Launcher, system UI, input methods, UI-less apps, and GodMode itself are not editable.
• If a crash occurs, a dialog appears on next launch to copy the crash log.
• All function buttons have tooltips (long-press or hover to view).
